## Original request

Fix shared-store approval latency and redundant remote reads

Original report. Approving an issue takes well over 30 seconds again. Reproduce by approving issue 176 and other pending items, then fix the slowdown. Escalate shared causes beyond approval when supported by evidence.

Observed in this repair. Issues 176 and 181 both approved successfully after remaining pending beyond 30 seconds. Live store refresh diagnostics showed 23 to 29 seconds. Git-backed Coordination storage is named files. Decoding overflow records resolves artifact relocation through separate authoritative Git reads even while a pinned snapshot is open.

Repair in progress. Keep overflow decoding within its exact provider snapshot, including nested Issue snapshots. Keep ordinary reads and mutation authority fresh. Revoke completed read scopes.

Verification. The focused real-Git fixture failed before the fix with five remote head lookups for four overflow records, then passed with one. Check relocation identity, concurrent and detached tasks, fresh peer reads, and write revision guards. Re-test live approval after restarting the idle server. Retain any remaining latency as an open issue rather than claiming the whole delay fixed.

<!-- prettier-ignore-end -->

## Performance repair evidence, 23 November 2026

The local source now reuses pinned overflow reads, scopes approval freshness to the selected issue, and commits same-store ordinary report publications atomically. A real Git fixture reduced durable approval commits from five to one while retaining claim, migration, flow, report, replay, and uncertain-outcome guards.

Live profiling also found repeated polling work. The repair reuses parsed file generations, validates evidence actions freshly, sizes evidence display metadata by bytes for histories with thousands of references, and shares one folder catalogue and field list per view. File replacements, resolver changes, cache races, and executable replacement have regressions.

The final live approval of issue 180 completed in 36.4 seconds. Original issue 176 was still pending after 71 seconds. This is one final live sample and is still above 30 seconds, so this issue remains open for the remaining approval latency. Do not treat approval or these source changes as issue acceptance.

Checks include a storage run with 222 passing checks and six optional external-service skips, 69 existing Flow checks, final focused integrity/settings checks, and the required step audit. Fallow was skipped under the repository default policy. Source changes remain uncommitted alongside pre-existing work.

Local evidence and next-step details are in .issues/evidence/approval-performance-20261123/README.md. The next step is to trace the remaining end-to-end Git admission and publication waits before choosing another change.
